rows.claim: Published request and agency response; not an appropriation or solicitation.
rows.explanation: Fund Park Enforcement Patrol Unit for Forest Park. Forest Park is host to many athletic facilities, recreational programs, and special events. It also has 543 acres of forest, which feature numerous hiking trails and a 4-mile equestrian path. Our park has a high volume of events and activities. Problems such as user conflicts permit violations, crowd control, vandalism, deviant behavior and other enforcement issues are in need of attention. Often, PEP nits are not available to respond to Forest Parks needs due to citywide distribution of their staff, and summer staffing of pools and beaches. This has created a rise in misuse of and vandalism to park facilities, damage to the landscape, criminal activity and mischief.
rows.headline: Enhance park safety through more security staff (police or parks enforcement)
rows.response: The agency recommends funding this budget request, but at this time the availability of funds is uncertain. OMB supports the agency's position.
